title.narrative: Technical Support for Economic Recovery and Social Protection in Nicaragua

description.narrative: UNOPS oversees an initiative for economic reactivation and social protection in Nicaragua funded by the Central American Bank for Economic Integration. It verifies the effective implementation (technical, environmental and social) of the applicable procedures, standards and policies, performs review of bidding files and program and project expenditures, verifies compliance with the Bank standard for new procurement processes and respective NIC-SOLIDARIA payments.
